result_text:
The per-rep purchase order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example. A test run filtered to `*PurchaseOrderCount*` finished with no output, which probably means no test matched, so nothing exercised the change.

The fix is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarterly report uses. The ordering is unchanged, and reps with no purchase orders still show 0. I also added a line about cancelled orders to the method's Javadoc.
